title: As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal
english: A scandal involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and an alleged Chinese intelligence operative has created new tensions ahead of meetings between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. The controversy has intensified concerns in Washington regarding the export of advanced AI chips, leading the US to implement stricter controls on firms attempting to bypass existing technology bans. As a result, China fears these developments will push the US to further restrict their access to critical computing technology, complicating future diplomatic discussions.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ እና ከቻይና የስለላ ድርጅት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው በተባሉ ግለሰብ ዙሪያ የተነሳው ቅሌት በዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና በዢ ጂንፒንግ መካከል በሚደረገው ስብሰባ ላይ ጥላውን ጥሏል። ይህ ክስተት በዋሽንግተን ያሉ ባለስልጣናት የላቁ የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት ቺፖችን ወደ ቻይና ስለ መላክ ያላቸውን ስጋት ያባባሰው ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካም የቴክኖሎጂ እቀባዎችን የሚያልፉ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንድትወስድ አድርጓታል። በዚህም ምክንያት ቻይና፣ አሜሪካ በወሳኝ የቴክኖሎጂ አቅርቦቶች ላይ ተጨማሪ እገዳዎችን ትጥላለች የሚል ስጋት ገብቷታል።
oromo: Hoji gaggeessaa duraanii Nvidia Jensen Huang fi namoota basaastota Chaayinaa waliin walitti hidhata qabu jedhamee shakkamu irratti kan xiyyeeffate saaxilamuun isaa, marii Donald Trump fi Xi Jinping gidduutti taasifamuuf jiru irratti dhiibbaa uumeera. Dhimmi kun mootummaan Ameerikaa teeknoolojii AI fi chipiiwwan ammayyaa Chaayinaatti ergamu irratti dhiibbaa akka guddisu taasiseera. Chaayinaan, rakkoon kun Ameerikaan teeknoolojiiwwan murteessoo ta'an irratti dhorkaa cimaa akka keessu ishee sodaachiseera.

title: Rubio says US not 'under systemic attack' after series of tech outages
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has clarified that recent nationwide technical glitches affecting banks, airlines, and major tech companies are unrelated and not the result of a cyberattack. Officials and cybersecurity experts explain that these disruptions were caused by routine system updates and outdated infrastructure rather than malicious activity. The government is working to reassure the public that there is no systemic threat to national security.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በቅርቡ በባንኮች፣ በአየር መንገዶች እና በቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ላይ የተከሰቱት የቴክኒክ ችግሮች እርስ በርስ የተያያዙ አለመሆናቸውንና የሳይበር ጥቃት አለመሆናቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። የሳይበር ደህንነት ባለሙያዎች እና የመንግስት አካላት እንደገለጹት ችግሮቹ የቆዩ መሠረተ ልማቶችን በማሻሻል ሂደት የተፈጠሩ እንጂ በማንኛውም አካል የታቀደ ጥቃት አይደለም። መንግስት ህዝቡ ስጋት እንዳይገባበት እና አገሪቱ ከሳይበር ጥቃት ነጻ መሆኗን ለማረጋገጥ እየሰራ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo rakkooleen teeknoolojii yeroo dhihoo kana bankoota, xiyyaaraa fi dhaabbilee teeknoolojii gurguddaa irratti mudatan wal-qabataa fi qindeeffamaa akka hin taane fi haleellaa saayibarii akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Ogeeyyiin saayibarii fi qondaalonni mootummaa akka jedhanitti, rakkooleen kun kan uumaman fooyya'iinsa sirnaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa kisaa ta'an irraa malee, haleellaa diinaa miti. Mootummaan ummanni akka hin sodaanne fi biyyattiin miidhaa saayibarii akka hin mudanne mirkaneessuuf hojjachaa jira.

title: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began
english: Democrat Mary Peltola has secured a Senate victory in Alaska following a lengthy vote-counting process that lasted two weeks. This win strengthens the Democratic Party's position in Congress after a contentious campaign marked by legal disputes and controversy over alleged voter confusion tactics. Peltola’s success concludes a notable election season for her party, emphasizing her commitment to addressing the urgent economic needs of Alaskan residents.
amharic: ዲሞክራቷ ሜሪ ፔልቶላ የሁለት ሳምንት ድምጽ ቆጠራን ተከትሎ በአላስካ የሴኔት ምርጫ አሸናፊ ሆነዋል። ይህ ድል በህጋዊ ክርክሮች እና በተለያዩ ውዝግቦች የታጀበውን የምርጫ ሂደት ያጠናቀቀ ሲሆን የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ በኮንግረስ ያለውን ተፅዕኖ አጠናክሮታል። ፔልቶላ በአላስካ ነዋሪዎች ላይ የተጋረጡትን የኢኮኖሚ ችግሮች ለመፍታት ቃል በመግባት አሸናፊነቷን አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Marii Peltola kan paartii Dimokiraata taate filannoo senetii Alaska torban lama guutuu sagalee lakkaawamee booda injifatteetti. Injifannoon kun falmii seeraa fi waldhabiin kan itti baay'ate ta'us, guddina paartii Dimokiraata kan mirkaneesse dha. Peltola rakkoolee diinagdee jiraattota Alaska mudachaa jiran furuuf waadaa galuun injifannoo ishee kana galmeessiteetti.

title: India-UK ties outride Modi’s ‘decolonisation’ rhetoric
english: Despite Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s political rhetoric focused on moving beyond the country's British colonial legacy, the partnership between India and the UK continues to strengthen. The recent visit of Prince William and the Princess of Wales highlights these enduring diplomatic ties, which are supported by a new free trade agreement. Experts suggest that India can confidently address its historical past while maintaining a modern, equal, and economically beneficial relationship with Britain.
amharic: የህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ የሀገሪቱን የብሪቲሽ ቅኝ ግዛት ታሪክ ለማስወገድ የሚያደርጉት ጥረት ቢኖርም፣ በህንድ እና በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት እየጠነከረ ነው። የልዑል ዊሊያም እና የዌልስ ልዕልት ካትሪን የቅርብ ጊዜ ጉብኝት፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ጠንካራ የዲፕሎማሲ እና የንግድ ትስስር ያሳያል። ተንታኞች እንደሚናገሩት ከሆነ ህንድ ካለፈው ታሪኳ ጋር እየተታረቀች፣ ከብሪታኒያ ጋር ዘመናዊ እና በጋራ ተጠቃሚነት ላይ የተመሰረተ ግንኙነትን መቀጠል ትችላለች።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Hindii Narendra Moodiin seenaa koloneeffataa Biriiteen irraa walaba ta'uuf carraaqqii godhanis, hariiroon Hindii fi UK gidduu jiru daran jabaachaa jira. Daawwannaan illee Wiiliyam fi ishee guddittii Weels Keetiriin godhan hariiroo dippilomaasii fi daldalaa cimaa lamaan isaanii gidduu jiru kan mirkaneessudha. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, Hindii seenaa ishee darbe kabajaafi qabachaa, Biriiteen wajjin hariiroo ammayyaa fi faayidaa waloo irratti hundaa'e itti fufuu akka dandeessudha.

title: Myanmar-linked arsenic pollution prompts clean water scramble in Thailand
english: Thai authorities are rushing to supply clean water to over 20,000 households in Chiang Rai after arsenic levels in the local water supply exceeded safety limits by thirty times. This contamination has been linked to unregulated gold and rare earth mining activities occurring across the border in Myanmar. The government is currently distributing fresh water via trucks while investigating alternative water sources to protect residents from toxic runoff entering the river system.
amharic: በታይላንድ የቺያንግ ራይ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኘው የውሃ አቅርቦት ውስጥ ከደረጃው በላይ የሆነ የአርሴኒክ መርዝ በመገኘቱ ከ20,000 በላይ ቤተሰቦች ለችግር ተዳርገዋል። ይህ መርዛማ ንጥረ ነገር በጎረቤት ምያንማር በሚካሄዱ ቁጥጥር ያልተደረገባቸው የወርቅ እና የማዕድን ማውጣት ስራዎች ምክንያት የተከሰተ እንደሆነ ታውቋል። የታይላንድ መንግስት ለተጎዱ ነዋሪዎች የንፁህ ውሃ አቅርቦትን በሎሪዎች በማድረስ ላይ ሲሆን ሌሎች አማራጭ የውሃ ምንጮችንም በመፈለግ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Naannoo Chiang Rai kan biyya Taayilaanditti, bishaan dhugaatii keessatti summiin 'arseniik' jedhamu daangaa eegumsa fayyaa irra darbee waan argameef, maatiiwwan 20,000 ol ta'an rakkinaaf saaxilamaniiru. Balaan kun kan uumame hojiiwwan qonnaan ykn albuuda baasuu kan biyya Myaanmaaritti seeraan ala geggeeffamaa jiran irraa akka ta'e mirkanaa'eera. Mootummaan Taayilaand jiraattotaaf bishaan qulqulluu konkolaataan dhiyeessaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, furmaata waaraa argachuufis qorannoo geggeessaa jira.

title: Paris Hilton and AOC speak against AI-generated deepfakes
english: Paris Hilton and Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez have joined forces to condemn the creation of AI-generated deepfakes that specifically target women and young girls. They are calling for urgent action on the Defiance Act, a piece of legislation passed by the US Senate months ago that has yet to be implemented. The duo is pushing for these protections to be enforced to prevent further digital harassment and exploitation.
amharic: ፓሪስ ሂልተን እና የኮንግረስ አባል አሌክሳንድሪያ ኦካሲዮ-ኮርቴዝ ሴቶችን እና ወጣት ልጃገረዶችን ዒላማ ያደረጉ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ (AI) የተፈጠሩ የውሸት ምስሎችን እና ቪዲዮዎችን በአንድነት ተቃውመዋል። ከወራት በፊት በአሜሪካ ሴኔት የፀደቀው ነገር ግን እስካሁን ተግባራዊ ያልሆነውን 'Defiance Act' ህግ እንዲተገበር እየወተወቱ ነው። ሁለቱ ታዋቂ ሰዎች ዲጂታል ትንኮሳን እና ብዝበዛን ለመከላከል የህግ ከለላዎች በአስቸኳይ እንዲሰሩ ግፊት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Paaris Hiiltan fi miseensi Koongirasii Aleksaandiriyaa Ookaasiyoo-Korteez sagalee isaanii tokko taasisuun, fayyadamtoota seeraan ala AI fayyadamuun suuraa ykn viidiyoo sobaa dubartoota fi shamarran irratti hojjetamu balaaleeffataniiru. Isaanis seera 'Defiance Act' jedhamu kan ji'oota hedduu dura Mana Maree Senetii Ameerikaa keessatti darbe garuu hanga ammaa hojiirra hin oolle akka ariitiidhaan hojiirra oolu gaafataniiru. Namoonni kunneen miidhaa fi balleessee miidiyaa hawaasaa keessatti raawwatamu ittisuuf seera kana akka cimsuu qaban itti fayyadamtootaa fi qaama dhimmi ilaalu gorsaniiru.

title: Venezuelan boxer Linares arrested in US and faces deportation, ICE confirms
english: Former Venezuelan boxing world champion Jorge Linares is currently in custody after being detained by U.S. immigration authorities at the El Paso International Airport. While officials state he is being held for deportation due to a lack of legal immigration status, his legal team maintains that he is authorized to be in the country. His lawyers are working with authorities to resolve the situation, while the boxer remains at a processing center in Texas.
amharic: የቀድሞው የቬንዙዌላ የዓለም ቦክስ ሻምፒዮን ጆርጅ ሊናሬስ በኤል ፓሶ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በአሜሪካ የኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ተይዞ በእስር ላይ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናቱ አትሌቱ ህጋዊ የመኖሪያ ፍቃድ ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት ለስደት ሂደት እንደተያዘ ቢገልጹም፣ ጠበቆቹ ግን በአሜሪካ የመቆየት ህጋዊ ፈቃድ እንዳለው ይከራከራሉ። የህግ ባለሙያዎቹ ጉዳዩን በአፋጣኝ ለመፍታት ከሚመለከታቸው አካላት ጋር እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ቦክሰኛው በአሁኑ ጊዜ በቴክሳስ በሚገኝ ማቆያ ጣቢያ ይገኛል።
oromo: Leenjiisaan boorsii addunyaa kan duraanii kan ta'e Jorge Linares, buufata xiyyaaraa El Paso keessatti aangotni immigreeshinii Amerikaatiin qabamee hidhaatti darbeera. Aangotni kun akka jedhanitti, Linares kan qabame ulaagaa seeraa biyyattii waan hin guunneef gara biyyatti deebisuuf yaadamee akka ta'e ibsanis, gorsitootni seeraa isaa garuu inni biyyattii keessa jiraachuuf heeyyama akka qabu dubbatu. Gareen seeraa isaa dhimma kana ariitiin furuuf aangota wajjin hojjechaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, inni garuu yeroof buufata qabii keessatti argama.

title: ‘We want to go back’: Rohingya refugees pin hopes on ICJ genocide verdict
english: Rohingya refugees living in Bangladesh are waiting for a landmark International Court of Justice ruling regarding genocide allegations against Myanmar. Families who fled the 2017 military crackdown hope that a favorable verdict will validate their suffering and support their desire to return home. Despite their optimism, many remain uncertain about whether a legal victory will lead to immediate improvements in their living conditions or a safe path back to Myanmar.
amharic: በባንግላዲሽ የሚገኙ የሮሂንጋ ስደተኞች በማያንማር ላይ በቀረበው የዘር ማጥፋት ክስ ዓለም አቀፉ የፍትህ ፍርድ ቤት የሚሰጠውን ውሳኔ በጉጉት እየጠበቁ ነው። በ2017 ከወታደራዊ ጥቃት የተረፉት እነዚህ ስደተኞች፣ የፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔ ለደረሰባቸው መከራ እውቅና በመስጠት ወደ ሀገራቸው ለመመለስ የሚደረገውን ጥረት እንደሚያግዝ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ። ሆኖም የህግ ድል ቢገኝም፣ በኑሯቸው ላይ ፈጣን ለውጥ ያመጣል ወይስ ወደ ሀገራቸው የመመለስ ዕድል ይፈጥራል የሚለው አሁንም አጠያያቂ ነው።
oromo: Baangilaadhesh keessatti kan argaman baqattoonni Rohinjiyaa himata sanyii balleessuu Maayaanmaar irratti dhiyaate ilaalchisee murtii Mana Murtii Addunyaa eeggachaa jiru. Namoonni bara 2017 haleellaa waraanaa irraa baqatan kun, murtii tolaa ta'e tokko rakkoo isaan irra ga'eef beekamtii kennee gara biyya isaaniitti deebi'uuf akka isaan gargaaru abdii qabu. Ta'us, injifannoon seeraa kun jireenya isaanii irratti jijjiirama hatattamaa fida ykn gara biyyaatti deebi'uuf karaa mijataa uuma jedhamee hin eegamu.

title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
english: Nvidia reported a massive financial success, with sales and profits doubling to reach record levels despite the recent departure of co-founder Jensen Huang. The company's leadership confirmed they have no intention of bringing Huang back, emphasizing that operations remain stable and growth will continue. While some analysts worry about future strategic direction, the company's strong performance has eased immediate concerns regarding the tech firm's momentum.
amharic: ኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) መስራች ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከኩባንያው ቢለቁም፣ የገቢ እና የትርፍ መጠኑ በእጥፍ በማደግ ታሪካዊ ውጤት ማስመዝገቡን አስታውቋል። የኩባንያው አመራሮች ሁአንግን ወደ ስልጣን ለመመለስ ምንም አይነት እቅድ እንደሌላቸው እና ስራው በተለመደው ሁኔታ እንደሚቀጥል አረጋግጠዋል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ ተንታኞች ስለወደፊት ስትራቴጂካዊ ውሳኔዎች ስጋት ቢኖራቸውም፣ ኩባንያው ያስመዘገበው ጠንካራ የፋይናንስ ውጤት የገበያ ተስፋዎችን አድሶታል።
oromo: Nvidia bu'aa gabaa guddaa galmeessiseera; haa ta'u malee, dhaabbata kana kan hundeesse Jensen Huang gadi lakkisuun isaa ni yaadatama. Bulchiinsi dhaabbatichaa akka ibsetti, Huang deebisanii dhaabuuf karoorri tokkollee akka hin jirre fi hojiin isaanii haala gaariin itti fufaa akka jiru mirkaneessaniiru. Namoonni gabaa xiinxalan tokko tokko gara fuulduraatti tarsiimoo dhaabbatichaa ilaalchisee yaaddoo qabaatanis, bu'aan isaanii inni quubsaan yaaddoo kana furuun guddina isaanii agarsiiseera.

title: Thomas Markle charged over child sex abuse material in Philippines
english: Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, is facing new criminal charges in the Philippines for possessing and intending to distribute child sexual abuse material. This follows his recent arrest in the United States, where authorities seized evidence from his storage units. Markle, who is currently in U.S. custody, has denied these serious allegations while remaining estranged from his daughter.
amharic: የሜጋን ማርክል አባት የሆኑት ቶማስ ማርክል፣ ህገ-ወጥ የህጻናት የወሲብ ምስሎችን በመያዝ እና ለማሰራጨት በማቀድ በፊሊፒንስ ክስ ተመሰረተባቸው። ይህ ክስ የተመሰረተው በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ ከተያዙ በኋላ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ከእሳቸው መጋዘኖች ተያያዥ ማስረጃዎችን አግኝተዋል። በአሁኑ ጊዜ በአሜሪካ እስር ላይ የሚገኙት ቶማስ ማርክል የተከሰሱባቸውን ድርጊቶች αρነውታል፤ ከልጃቸው ሜጋንም ጋር ያላቸው ግንኙነት የተቋረጠ መሆኑ ይታወቃል።
oromo: Abbaan Meghan Markle kan ta'an Thomas Markle, biyya Filippiins keessatti qabiyyee saal-qunnamtii daa'immanii kan seeraan alaa qabatanii argamuufi raabsudhaaf karooruun himatamaniiru. Himannaan kun kan dhufu, yeroo ammaa kana Ameerikaa keessatti qabamanii erga himatamanii booda yoo ta'u, qorattoonni mana kuusaa isaanii keessaa ragaa tokko tokko argachuu isaanii ibsameera. Thomas Markle yeroo ammaa Ameerikaatti hidhamanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, himannaa kana kan haalan yoo ta'u, mucaa isaanii wajjinis walitti dhufeenyi isaanii kan addaan citeedha.

title: 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge
english: Russian missile strikes hit major bridges in Kyiv late Monday, causing significant structural damage and forcing the closure of the Northern bridge. Residents living nearby, including a mother named Masha, described the terrifying explosions that forced them to seek immediate shelter. Emergency crews are currently assessing the damage, though the attacks have caused widespread travel disruptions across the city.
amharic: የሩሲያ ሚሳኤሎች ሰኞ ምሽት በኪየቭ ዋና ዋና ድልድዮች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘራቸው ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶ ድልድዮቹ እንዲዘጉ ተደርገዋል። ማሻ የተባለች እናት እና ቤተሰቧን ጨምሮ በአካባቢው የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች፣ የፍንዳታው ድምፅ እጅግ አስፈሪ እንደነበር እና ለመጠለል መገደዳቸውን ገልጸዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በቦታው ላይ ጉዳቱን እየገመገሙ ቢሆንም፣ ጥቃቱ በከተማዋ የመንገድ ትራፊክ ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Halkan Wiixata darbe, boombiin Ruusiyaa daandiiwwan gurguddoo magaalaa Kiyyivitti argaman rukutuun miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Miidhaa kanaan walqabatee, daandiin ‘Northern bridge’ jedhamu akka cufamu ta’eera. Jiraattonni naannichaa, kanneen akka haadha mana tokkoo Maashaa, sagaleen dhukaatii sun akka malee sodaachisaa akka turee fi bakka dhokatan barbaaduuf akka dirqaman dubbataniiru. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa miidhaa sana qorachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, haleellaan kun imala magaalaa keessaa irratti gufuu guddaa uumee jira.

title: What is Trump hoping to achieve at APEC meeting in China?
english: President Donald Trump is attending the APEC summit in China to hold discussions with Chinese President Xi Jinping and potentially Russian President Vladimir Putin. While this marks their third meeting this year, experts anticipate the talks will remain largely symbolic rather than resulting in major policy breakthroughs regarding trade, AI, or Taiwan. These diplomatic efforts occur as Trump faces increased political pressure domestically following recent losses in the US Congress.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቻይና በሚካሄደው የኤፔክ (APEC) ጉባኤ ላይ ለመሳተፍ እና ከቻይናው ፕሬዝዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ እንዲሁም ምናልባትም ከሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር ለመወያየት ዝግጅት አድርገዋል። የዘንድሮው ሦስተኛው ስብሰባ ቢሆንም፣ በንግድ፣ በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ እና በታይዋን ጉዳዮች ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ የሚያመጣ ስምምነት ይኖራል ተብሎ አይጠበቅም። ይህ ጉባኤ በትራምፕ ላይ በአሜሪካ ኮንግረስ በደረሰው ሽንፈት ሳቢያ የውስጥ ፖለቲካዊ ጫና ባለበት ወቅት የሚካሄድ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaanald Traamp gubaa'ii APEC kan Chaayinaatti taasifamu irratti hirmaachuun, pireezidaantii Chaayinaa Sii Jiinpiingii fi tarii pireezidaantii Raashiyaa Vilaadimiir Puutiin waliin mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru. Kun wal arguun isaanii kan sadaffaa ta'us, dhimmoota daldalaa, teknooloojii fi Taayiwaan irratti bu'aa qabatamaa ta'e tokko ni argamsiisa jedhamee hin eeggamu. Mariin kun kan gaggeeffamu Traamp filannoo biyyoolessaa Ameerikaa booda dhiibbaa siyaasaa keessoo irratti uumamee jiru keessatti dha.

title: Prosecutors allege man ‘destroyed’ US military plane at Irish airport
english: A 48-year-old Irish man, Daithi O’Corrain, has been indicted for causing severe damage to a US military C-130 aircraft at Shannon Airport. Prosecutors claim he used an axe and other tools to sabotage the plane as an act of protest against US foreign policy in the Middle East. The aircraft, valued at $60 million, was left inoperable, and the suspect now faces potential federal charges in New York that could result in a 10-year prison sentence.
amharic: ዳይቲ ኦኮሬን የተባለ የ48 ዓመት የቆጵሮስ ተወላጅ፣ በአየርላንድ ሻነን አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ የቆመ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት በማድረስ ተከሰሰ። ግለሰቡ በአሜሪካ የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ፖሊሲ ላይ ተቃውሞውን ለመግለጽ መጥረቢያ በመጠቀም አውሮፕላኑን አበላሽቷል። 60 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመተው ይህ አውሮፕላን ጥቅም ላይ የማይውል ሲሆን፣ ተጠርጣሪው በኒውዮርክ በፍርድ ቤት ቢቀርብ እስከ 10 ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊቀጣ ይችላል።
oromo: Namni umriin isaa 48 ta'e Daithi O’Corrain jedhamu, buufata xiyyaaraa Shannonitti xiyyaara waraana Amerikaa C-130 irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera jedhamee himatameera. Namichi kun siyaasa Amerikaa kan Baha Giddu-galeessaa mormuuf jecha, qottoo fi meeshaalee biroo fayyadamuun xiyyaaricha mancaasuu isaa qorattoonni ibsaniiru. Xiyyaarri doolaara miiliyoona 60 baasu kun guutummaatti kan barbadaa'e yoo ta'u, shakkamichi yoo yakka kanaan irratti mirkanaa'e waggaa 10 hamma ta'u hidhamuu danda'a.

title: Man charged over ‘brutal attack’ on Somali-American in Minnesota
english: A 25-year-old man named Samit Apurva Patel has been charged with attempted murder and carjacking following a violent attack on a Somali-American Uber driver in Minnesota. The victim, Mohamed Yusuf, remains in critical condition after being strangled and run over by his own vehicle. While the victim’s family suspects the assault was motivated by hate, prosecutors stated they currently lack sufficient evidence to file hate crime charges.
amharic: ሳሚት አፑርቫ ፓቴል የተባለ የ25 ዓመት ወጣት በሚኒሶታ የሶማሌ አሜሪካዊ የሆነ የኡበር ሹፌር ላይ በፈጸመው አሰቃቂ ጥቃት በግድያ ሙከራ እና በመኪና ዘረፋ ተከሷል። ተጎጂው መሐመድ ዩሱፍ በታነቀበት እና በራሱ መኪና በተገጨበት ወቅት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበት በአስጊ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛል። የቤተሰቡ አባላት ጥቃቱ በዘረኝነት የተፈጸመ እንደሆነ ቢጠረጥሩም፣ አቃቤ ህግ እስካሁን ድረስ ይህንን የሚያረጋግጥ በቂ ማስረጃ የለም ብለዋል።
oromo: Namni umriin isaa waggaa 25 ta'e, Saamit Apurvaa Paatel jedhamu, miinisootaatti konkolaataa Uber kan oofu lammii Ameerikaa kan ta'e Soomaaliyaa tokko irratti miidhaa hamaa waan geessiseef, yaalii ajjeechaa fi saaminsa konkolaataatiin himatameera. Miidhamtuun, Mohaammad Yuusuf, harkisamee fi konkolaataa isaa mataa isaatiin waan irra darbameef, haala hamaa keessa jira. Maatiin isaa haleellaan kun jibbaa irratti hundaa'ee kan raawwatame ta'uu shakkanis, abbaan alangaa himata yakka jibbaa banuuf ragaan ga'aan hin jiru jedhaniiru.

title: Protests as Jason Arday’s accuser speaks at Oxford University
english: Hundreds of protesters gathered at Oxford University to demonstrate against American academic Nathan Cofnas during his appearance at a student event. Cofnas has been widely criticized for accusing the late Cambridge professor Jason Arday of plagiarism. Many activists believe his public campaign against Arday was a targeted harassment effort that negatively impacted the professor before his passing.
amharic: በኦክስፎርድ ዩኒቨርሲቲ በተካሄደ ዝግጅት ላይ አሜሪካዊው ምሁር ናታን ኮፍናስ ንግግር ለማድረግ በመገኘታቸው በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። ኮፍናስ የቀድሞውን የካምብሪጅ ፕሮፌሰር ጄሰን አርዳይን በምርምር ስርቆት በመክሰሳቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት ሲሰነዘርባቸው ቆይተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በፕሮፌሰር አርዳይ ላይ የተደረገው ይህ ዘመቻ ግለሰቡ ከመሞታቸው በፊት ለደረሰባቸው ጉዳት አስተዋጽኦ ያደረገ አድሎአዊ ድርጊት ነው ብለው ያምናሉ።
oromo: Yuunivarsitii Oksfoordiitti hayyuu Ameerikaa Naataan Kofnaas sirna tokko irratti argamuu isaatiin wal-qabatee namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman mormii dhageessisaniiru. Kofnaas piroofeesara kaambrijii kan ta'an Jeeson Arday irratti himata hatuu qorannoo dhiyeessuudhaan komatamaa turaniiru. Mormitootni akka jedhanitti, Kofnaas piroofeesaricha irratti duula gaggeessaa turee fi kunis du'a isaanii dura miidhaa cimaa akka isaan irra ga'u sababa ta'eera.

title: Board of Peace warns Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse without action
english: The US-supported Board of Peace has alerted the UN Security Council that the 2025 ceasefire in Gaza is nearing failure due to persistent fighting and delays in fulfilling agreement terms. The board highlighted that ongoing Israeli military strikes and significant obstacles to delivering humanitarian aid are worsening the living conditions for displaced Palestinians. Without urgent corrective measures to bridge the gap between promises and reality, officials warn that the fragile truce will likely fall apart.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የሚንቀሳቀሰው የሰላም ቦርድ እ.ኤ.አ በ2025 የተደረገው የጋዛ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት፣ ቀጣይነት ባለው ግጭት እና በስምምነቱ ውሎች አፈጻጸም መጓተት ምክንያት የመፍረስ አደጋ እንደተጋረጠበት ለተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት አስታውቋል። ቦርዱ በእስራኤል በኩል የሚደረጉ የአየር ጥቃቶች እና ለሰብአዊ ዕርዳታ መግቢያ የተቀመጡ ገደቦች በጋዛ የሚገኙ ተፈናቃዮችን ህይወት እጅግ አስቸጋሪ እንዳደረገው ገልጿል። በስምምነቱ እና በተግባራዊ እንቅስቃሴው መካከል ያለውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት ፈጣን እርምጃ ካልተወሰደ፣ ተሰባሪው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ሊቀለበስ እንደሚችል ማስጠንቀቂያ ተሰጥቷል።
oromo: Boordiin Nageenyaa kan US deeggaramu, walii galteen dhaabbii waraanaa bara 2025 Gaazaa keessatti mallatteeffame, waraanni itti fufuu fi waliigaltee kabajuu dadhabuu irraa kan ka'e diigamuuf akka jiru mana maree nageenyaa UN-tti ibseera. Boordichi tarkaanfiin waraana Israa'el fi daangaan gargaarsa namoomaa irratti godhamaa jiru, jireenya namoota buqqa'anii rakkoo cimaa keessa jiran caalaatti hammeesseera jedheera. Waliigaltee kanaan dura turee fi haala lafa irra jiru gidduutti garagarummaan jiraachuun isaa, dhaabbii waraana kanaa kan shakkiif saaxile ta'uu fi tarkaanfiin ariifachiisaan yoo hin fudhatamne waliigalteen kun diigamuu akka danda'u hubachiiseera.

title: How the attack on Crimean Bridge unfolded
english: Ukraine successfully destroyed a key section of the Crimean Bridge through a sophisticated seven-stage military operation. By systematically neutralizing Russian air defenses and radar systems over several weeks, Ukrainian forces cleared a path for a final, precise missile strike. This attack highlights Ukraine's increasing capability to penetrate Russia's strongest defenses and target infrastructure vital to their occupation.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሰባት ደረጃ በተከፈለ ውስብስብ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን የክራይሚያን ድልድይ ወሳኝ ክፍል ማውደም ችላለች። የዩክሬን ኃይሎች ለበርካታ ሳምንታት የሩሲያን የአየር መከላከያ እና የራዳር ሲስተሞች በተከታታይ በመምታት ለዋናው የሮኬት ጥቃት አመቺ ሁኔታን ፈጥረዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ዩክሬን የሩሲያን ጠንካራ መከላከያ ሰብሮ በመግባት ስልታዊ ጠቀሜታ ያላቸውን መሠረተ ልማቶች መምታት እንደምትችል ያሳያል።
oromo: Yukireen duula waraanaa sadarkaa torba qabuun daandii gubbaa biyya Kirimeya kutaa barbaachisaa ta'e diiguu dandeesseetti. Humnoonni Yukireen torbanoota hedduuf sirna ittisa qilleensaa fi raadaaroota Raashiyaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun, dhukaasa rookeettii dhumaaf haala mijataa uumaniiru. Hojiin kun Yukireen ittisa Raashiyaa kan jabaa ta'e cabsitee bu'uuraalee misoomaa humnichaaf barbaachisoo ta'an rukutuuf dandeettii akka qabdu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Jensen Huang says he would be 'honoured' to return as Nvidia CEO if board asked him
english: Jensen Huang has expressed a willingness to return as Nvidia's CEO following his resignation amid a personal scandal involving extramarital affairs and security concerns. Despite his statement, the company's board has ruled out his return and is currently investigating his conduct. Huang also faces impending questioning from U.S. lawmakers regarding his personal association with an alleged foreign intelligence asset.
amharic: ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ ከግል ህይወቱ ጋር በተያያዘ ከተነሳው ቅሌት እና ከስራ መልቀቂያው በኋላ ወደ ኤንቪዲያ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚነት ለመመለስ ፍላጎት እንዳለው ገልጿል። ሆኖም የኩባንያው ቦርድ እርሱን ለመመለስ ምንም አይነት ፍላጎት እንደሌለው እና ድርጊቱን በምርመራ ላይ እንደሚገኝ አስታውቋል። በተጨማሪም ሁዋንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር በተያያዘ በተነሳው ውዝግብ ምክንያት በአሜሪካ ህግ አውጪዎች ጥያቄ እንደሚቀርብለት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ dhimma qulqullinaa fi hariiroo alaa seeraa waliin walqabatee gadi lakkisee booda, ammas gara hogganaa Nvidia-tti deebi'uuf fedhii akka qabu ibseera. Ta'us, boordiin dhaabbatichaa gara hojiitti deebi'uu isaa akka hin fudhanne fi ammas dhimma isaarratti qorannoo geggeessaa akka jiran beekameera. Kana malees, hiriyaa isaa kan jedhamtu tokko kan shakkamu ragaa iccitii mootummaa Chaayinaa ta'uun isheetiif, qaamoleen seera baastuu Ameerikaa gaaffii isatti kaasuuf qophaa'aa jiru.

title: Russian military plane crashes killing all 19 on board
english: A Russian military transport plane crashed in the Kemerovo region of Siberia during a routine flight, resulting in the deaths of all 19 people on board. Initial reports from the defense ministry suggest that a mechanical failure caused the aircraft to go down in an isolated area. Emergency crews quickly arrived to put out fires at the scene, and aviation officials have launched a formal investigation into the incident.
amharic: በሩሲያ ሳይቤሪያ ክልል በአውሮፕላን አደጋ ሁሉም በውስጡ የነበሩ 19 ሰዎች መሞታቸውን የሀገሪቱ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል። አውሮፕላኑ በመደበኛ በረራ ላይ እያለ በቴክኒክ ብልሽት ሳቢያ ሰው በማይኖርበት አካባቢ እንደወደቀ ተገልጿል። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ቡድኖች በስፍራው ተገኝተው እሳቱን ማጥፋታቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ላይ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አሳውቀዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri geejjiba waraana Raashiyaa naannoo Sibiriyaatti kufuun namoonni 19 keessa turan hundi du'aniiru. Ministeerri ittisa biyyattii akka ibsetti, xiyyaarichi kufuun kan mudate erga balaliin idilee jalqabamee booda rakkoo teeknikaa mudateen akka ta'e dubbatameera. Gareewwan hatattamaa bakka sana ga'uun ibidda dhaamsuu danda'aniiru, akkasumas qaamoleen aangoo qaban balaa kana irratti qorannoo jalqabaniiru.

title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
english: The United States has officially lost its measles-free status after 26 years due to a significant rise in infections and deaths. Health officials attribute this setback to gaps in vaccination coverage, which have allowed the virus to circulate continuously for over a year. The government is now required to develop new strategies to improve immunization rates and regain its protected status.
amharic: አሜሪካ ባለፉት ሁለት ዓመታት የታየው የኩፍኝ በሽታ መጨመር እና የሰዎች ሞት ተከትሎ፣ ለ26 ዓመታት የቆየውን ከበሽታው ነጻ የሆነችበትን ደረጃ አጥታለች። የጤና ባለሙያዎች ይህ ሁኔታ የተፈጠረው በክትባት አሰጣጥ ላይ ባለው ክፍተት ምክንያት በሽታው ሳይቋረጥ ለአንድ ዓመት በላይ በመስፋፋቱ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። አገሪቱ ከዚህ በሽታ ነጻ ለመሆን የክትባት ሽፋን ለመጨመር አዳዲስ እቅዶችን ማውጣት ይጠበቅባታል።
oromo: Ameerikaan dhukkuba kofniin (measles) bilisa ta’uun ishee erga waggaa 26 booda sababa lakkoofsi namoota dhukkubichaan qabamanii fi du’anii dabaleef seenaa keessatti jalqabaaf haqeera. Ogeessonni fayyaa rakkoon kun kan dhufe haguuggiin talaallii gahaa waan hin taaneef, vaayirasichi waggaa tokkoo oliif walitti fufiinsaan tamsa’uu isaan akka ta’e ibsaniiru. Mootummaan biyyattii amma sadarkaa kanatti deebi’uuf sagantaa talaallii babal’isuu fi cimsuu irratti hojjechuu qaba.

title: Jeffries shifts strategy amid growing Democratic divisions in US House
english: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries has decided to hold a recorded vote for his speaker nomination instead of a standard unanimous vote. This strategic change aims to address internal Democratic divisions by requiring members to publicly declare their support. The move comes as some progressive lawmakers threaten to withhold their backing unless Jeffries agrees to specific policy concessions regarding foreign aid and campaign finance reform.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አናሳ መሪ ሃኪም ጄፍሪስ፣ ለምክር ቤቱ አፈ ጉባኤነት የሚደረገው ምርጫ በድምፅ ብልጫ ብቻ ሳይሆን በይፋዊ የድምፅ አሰጣጥ እንዲካሄድ ወስነዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ ያሉትን የውስጥ ክፍፍሎች ለመፍታት እና አባላት አቋማቸውን በግልፅ እንዲያሳዩ ለማስገደድ የታቀደ ነው። አንዳንድ የፓርቲው አባላት እንደ እስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርዳታ እና የምርጫ ፋይናንስ ማሻሻያ ባሉ ጉዳዮች ላይ ጄፍሪስ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን እንዲቀበሉ በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni garee xiqqaa mana maree bakka buutota Ummata Amerikaa, Hakeem Jeffries, filannoon afaan yaa'ii duraa sagalee guutuun osoo hin taane, sagalee kennuun akka gaggeeffamu murteessaniiru. Jijjiirraan tarsiimoo kun garee Dimookraataawaa keessatti wal dhabdee jiru ifa baasuuf fi miseensonni deeggarsa isaanii ifatti akka ibsan dirqisiisuuf gargaara. Kunis kan ta'e, miseensonni tokko tokko gargaarsa waraanaa fi jijjiirama maallaqa filannoo irratti akkaataa Jeffries itti hojjetan irratti mormii kaasuun isaanii hordofee dha.

title: Ugandan human trafficking survivor uses music to fight abuse
english: Gideon Mwesezi, a Ugandan musician who escaped human trafficking and forced labor in Myanmar, is now using his platform to advocate against similar crimes. Through his music, he warns his fellow citizens about the dangers of deceptive job offers that often lead to exploitation. His creative efforts serve as a proactive tool to protect others from falling victim to trafficking schemes.
amharic: በማያንማር የሰዎች ዝውውር እና በግዴታ የጉልበት ብዝበዛ ተጠቂ የነበረው ኡጋንዳዊው ድምፃዊ ጊዲዮን ምዌሴዚ፣ ሌሎች ሰዎች ለተመሳሳይ ወንጀል እንዳይጋለጡ በሙዚቃው አማካኝነት ግንዛቤ እየፈጠረ ነው። አርቲስቱ በተለይ አታላይ የሥራ ቅጥር ማስታወቂያዎች የሚያስከትሉትን አደጋ ለሕዝብ በማሳወቅ የሰዎችን ሕይወት ለመታደግ ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። ይህ የሙዚቃ ሥራው ተጎጂዎች እንዳይኖሩ ለመከላከል እንደ ትልቅ መሣሪያ እያገለገለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gidiyoon Mweesezii, muuziqeessaa biyya Ugaandaa kan ta'e fi biyya Miyaanmar keessatti gurgurtaa namaa fi dirqamaan hojjechiisuu irraa hafe, amma muuziqaa isaa fayyadamuun namoota biroo yakka kana irraa ittisuuf tattaaffachaa jira. Innis beeksisa hojii sobaa fi gowwoomsaa ta'e irratti xiyyeeffachuudhaan lammiileen isaa qabeenyaa fi qaama isaanii akka hin dhabne akeekkachiisa. Hojiin isaa kun namoonni biroon akka harka hammeenyaa kanatti hin kufne gargaaruuf kan yaadame dha.

title: Companies get billions in tariff refunds. Consumers are left with the bill.
english: Many American companies increased prices for shoppers to offset the costs of government tariffs. A recent investigation reveals these firms are now receiving billions in tax refunds, yet they are using the money to pay executive bonuses rather than reimbursing customers. Consequently, the public continues to bear the financial burden of these higher prices while corporations reap the benefits.
amharic: በርካታ የአሜሪካ ኩባንያዎች በመንግስት የተጣለባቸውን ቀረጥ ምክንያት በማድረግ የሸቀጦችን ዋጋ ጭረዋል። አሁን ግን እነዚህ ኩባንያዎች በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠር የግብር ተመላሽ ገንዘብ እያገኙ ቢሆንም፣ ገንዘቡን ለደንበኞቻቸው ከመመለስ ይልቅ ለከፍተኛ አመራሮቻቸው ጉርሻ እየከፈሉበት ይገኛል። በዚህም የተነሳ ሸማቾች በዋጋ ንረቱ ሲጎዱ፣ ኩባንያዎቹ ግን ከዚህ ድርጊት ተጠቃሚ ሆነዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbileen Amerikaa hedduun gibira mootummaan irratti kutee irraa kan ka'e gatii meeshaalee dabaluun isaanii ni yaadatama. Qorannoon tokko akka ibsutti, dhaabbileen kun amma gibira isaanii deebisanii argachaa jiranis, maallaqa kana maamiltootaaf deebisuu mannaa qondaaltota isaaniif badhaasa kaffaluuf itti fayyadamaa jiru. Kanaafuu, gatiin meeshaalee baay'ee qaaliin erga dabaree booda, fayyadamtoonni miidhamanii utuu jiranii dhaabbileen kunniin qabeenya kana ofiif fayyadamuurra jiru.

title: More than 100,000 take part in France pay protests
english: Thousands of people across France, including public sector employees and students, held nationwide protests to demand higher wages due to the rising cost of living. While the government reported around 146,000 participants, trade unions claimed the number was closer to 500,000. Workers are dissatisfied with current government pay offers, arguing that inflation has significantly reduced their purchasing power over the last several years.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ የሚኖሩ በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የመንግስት ሰራተኞች እና ተማሪዎች የኑሮ ውድነትን በመቃወም ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። መንግስት ተቃዋሚዎቹ 146,000 እንደሚደርሱ ቢገልጽም፣ የሰራተኛ ማህበራት ግን ቁጥራቸው ከግማሽ ሚሊዮን በላይ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ሰራተኞቹ የዋጋ ግሽበት የኑሮ ሁኔታቸውን እያባባሰው በመሆኑ መንግስት ደመወዛቸውን እንዲጨምርላቸው ይፈልጋሉ።
oromo: Faransaatti hojjettoonni mootummaa fi barattoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman baasii jireenyaa dabale mormuun hiriira guddaa taasisaniiru. Mootummaan hiriira kana irratti namoonni 146,000 hirmaachuu ibse, garuu gamtaan hojjettootaa lakkoofsi kun gara walakkaas miliyoonaa akka ga’u dubbatu. Hojjettoonni kunneen guddinni gatii meeshaalee (infleshiniin) rakkoo isaanii waan hammeesseef, mootummaan mindaa isaanii akka dabalu gaafachaa jiru.

title: NSA says outage of classified internal communications due to ‘maintenance’
english: The U.S. National Security Agency recently experienced an internal communications outage, which officials clarified was caused by scheduled maintenance rather than a cyberattack. The agency stated that their essential operations remain secure and functional despite the temporary disruption. This event follows a series of recent technological failures across various U.S. transportation and communication sectors.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ብሔራዊ ደህንነት ኤጀንሲ (NSA) በውስጥ መገናኛ አውታሩ ላይ አጋጥሞት የነበረው መስተጓጎል በሳይበር ጥቃት ሳይሆን በመደበኛ የጥገና ስራ የተከሰተ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ኤጀንሲው ይህ መስተጓጎል አጭር ጊዜ የወሰደ ቢሆንም፣ ወሳኝ የሆኑ ስራዎቹ ሳይስተጓጎሉ መቀጠላቸውን ገልጿል። ይህ ክስተት በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ የአየር ትራንስፖርት እና የቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፎች ከተከሰቱ ተከታታይ መስተጓጎሎች በኋላ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Ejensii nageenya biyyoolessaa Ameerikaa (NSA) interneetiin isaa addaan cituu isaa ilaalchisee ibsa kenneen, rakkoon kun kan dhufe ergaa sababii 'hacker' ykn miidhaa alaa osoo hin taane, hojii suphaa idilee ta'uu ibseera. Ejensichi rakkoon kun yeroo gabaabaaf kan ture ta'uu fi hojiileen isaanii kanneen murteessoo ta'an akka hin gufanne mirkaneesseera. Rakkoon kun kan quunnamu yeroo dhihoo as biyyattii keessatti damee geejjibaa fi teknoloojiin walqabatee rakkooleen garaagaraa mudachaa turan keessatti dha.

title: Opinion: Israel's genocide in Gaza continues. So must the protests
english: The author describes how displaced families in Gaza gathered nightly to watch news reports about the ongoing conflict. Using limited solar power, these groups sought information and a sense of hope amidst difficult conditions. The piece emphasizes the importance of continuing international protests against the situation in Gaza.
amharic: ደራሲው በጋዛ የተፈናቀሉ ቤተሰቦች በየዕለቱ ማታ ስለ ወቅታዊው ግጭት ዜና ለመከታተል እንዴት እንደሚሰባሰቡ ይገልጻሉ። በቂ የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል ባለመኖሩ፣ በፀሐይ ኃይል የሚሰሩ መሣሪያዎችን በመጠቀም አነስተኛ መረጃ ለማግኘት ይሞክራሉ። ጽሑፉ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ላለው ችግር ዓለም አቀፍ የተቃውሞ ድምፆች መቀጠል እንዳለባቸው ያሳስባል።
oromo: Barreessaan kun maatiiwwan Gaazaatti buqqa'an gabaasa waraanaa hordofuuf galgala galgala akkamitti akka walitti qabaman ibsa. Humna elektirikii waan hin jirreef, anniisaa aduurraa argamu fayyadamuun odeeffannoo fi abdii argachuuf yaalu. Barruun kun rakkoo Gaazaatti mudate mormuuf yaaliin addunyaa cichoominaan itti fufuu akka qabu dhaamsa dabarsa.

title: Two drones target Iranian Kurdish opposition bases in Iraq, sources say
english: Two explosive-equipped drones recently struck camps in Sulaymaniyah, Iraq, that are occupied by Iranian Kurdish opposition groups. The Iranian government frequently targets these locations, claiming that the groups are responsible for violent operations inside Iran. Security officials confirmed that these latest aerial attacks are part of an ongoing pattern of conflict in the region.
amharic: በኢራቅ ሱለይማኒያ ከተማ በሚገኙ የኢራን ኩርድ ተቃዋሚ ቡድን ካምፖች ላይ ሁለት ፈንጂ የጫኑ ድሮኖች ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። የኢራን መንግስት እነዚህ ቡድኖች በኢራን ውስጥ ለሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ተጠያቂ ናቸው በሚል በተደጋጋሚ ሲያጠቃቸው ቆይቷል። የጸጥታ ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ተደጋጋሚ ግጭት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Buufataalee mormitoota Kurdii kan Iran kan magaala Sulaymaniyah, Iraq keessatti argaman irratti, xiyyoorrni fe’umsa dhukaassaa qaban lama haleellaa raawwataniiru. Mootummaan Iran gareewwan kunneen Iran keessatti haleellaa raawwatu jechuun yeroo hedduu bakkeewwan kana rukutaa ture. Maddoonni nageenyaa akka ibsanitti, haleellaan kun walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa keessatti yeroo dheeraaf itti fufe keessaa isa tokko.

title: Iran-backed Iraqi group refuses to withdraw from stronghold
english: The Iran-aligned paramilitary group Kataeb Hezbollah has rejected an order from the Iraqi Prime Minister to vacate its base in Jurf al-Sakher. The government issued this ultimatum following allegations of illegal oil smuggling, which the militia strongly denies. While the group refuses to leave, its leadership stated that they aim to avoid any direct conflict with the national military.
amharic: ኢራን የምትደግፈው የካታኢብ ሄዝቦላህ ታጣቂ ቡድን በጁርፍ አል-ሳክሄር የሚገኘውን ይዞታውን ለቆ እንዲወጣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ የሰጡትን ትዕዛዝ አልቀበልም ብሏል። መንግስት ይህንን ውሳኔ ያስተላለፈው በቡድኑ ላይ በተነሳው የነዳጅ ኮንትሮባንድ ክስ ምክንያት ቢሆንም፣ ቡድኑ ክሱን ውድቅ አድርጎታል። ምንም እንኳን ታጣቂዎቹ አካባቢውን ለቀው ለመውጣት ፈቃደኛ ባይሆኑም፣ ከሀገሪቱ ጦር ጋር ግጭት ውስጥ መግባት እንደማይፈልጉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: gareen hidhattoota Iran degertu kan ta'e Kataeb Hezbollah, bakka buufata isaa kan Jurf al-Sakher gadhiisee akka bahu muummicha ministeeraa Iraaq irraa ajajamee ture hordofee diddaa dhageessise. Mootummaan ajaja kana kan kenne yakka kontirobaandii boba'aa irratti dhiyaate hordofuun yoo ta'u, gareen sun garuu yakka kana guutummaatti haaleera. Gareen hidhattootaa kun bakkeicha gadhiisuuf kan dide ta'us, waraana biyyaattii waliin walitti bu'iinsa uumuu akka hin barbaanne ibseera.

title: Israel's genocide in Gaza continues. So must the protests
english: Protesters worldwide are organizing to demand their governments and institutions take concrete action against Israel's military operations in Gaza. While many Palestinians initially felt abandoned by world leaders, they now find hope and support in these global demonstrations. Activists are successfully pressuring organizations to divest from ties to Israel and are calling for an immediate end to the supply of arms.
amharic: በዓለም ዙሪያ የሚገኙ ተቃዋሚዎች መንግሥታቸው እና ተቋማት በእስራኤል የጋዛ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ላይ ተጨባጭ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ በሰፊው እየተንቀሳቀሱ ነው። ብዙ ፍልስጤማውያን መጀመሪያ ላይ በአለም መሪዎች እንደተረሱ ቢሰማቸውም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት እነዚህ አለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞዎች ትልቅ ተስፋ እና ድጋፍ ሰጥተዋቸዋል። አክቲቪስቶችም ተቋማት ከእስራኤል ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጡ እና የጦር መሳሪያ አቅርቦት እንዲቆም በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hiriirtonni addunyaa maraa mootummoonni isaanii fi dhaabbileen garaagaraa tarkaanfii qabatamaa Israa'el duula waraana Gazaarratti fudhattu irratti akka fudhatan gaafachaa jiru. Yeroo jalqabaa namoonni Gaza keessa jiran hoogganoota addunyaatiin dagatamuu isaanii itti dhaga'amee ture, garuu hiriirri kun gara garaa addunyaatti geggeeffamu abdii fi deggarsa guddaa isaaniif ta'eera. Gootonni hiriira kana gaggeessan, dhaabbileen Israa'el waliin walitti dhufeenya qaban akka kutanii fi meeshaan waraanaa gara Israa'el ergamu akka dhaabbatu dhiibbaa gochaa jiru.

title: Yemen's Houthis say they launched drones towards Saudi East-West Pipeline
english: The Houthi group in Yemen announced that they carried out a drone attack against two oil pumping stations on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline. The militant organization claimed to have used five drones in the operation near the Riyadh region. Saudi authorities have not yet provided an official statement regarding the incident.
amharic: በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱት ሁቲዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ የምስራቅ-ምዕራብ የነዳጅ ቧንቧ መስመር ላይ በሚገኙ ሁለት የፓምፕ ጣቢያዎች ላይ የድሮን ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ በሪያድ አካባቢ በተፈጸመው በዚህ ጥቃት አምስት ድሮኖችን እንደተጠቀመ ገልጿል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት እስካሁን ስለ ጉዳዩ የሰጡት ይፋዊ መግለጫ የለም።
oromo: gareen Huutii kan Yemenitti argamu, buufataalee piampii boba'aa lama kan biyya Saudi Arabiyaa keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa xiyyara gargaarsa malee balali'uun (drone) raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gareen kun haleellaa naannoo Riyadhitti raawwatame kana keessatti xiyyara shan fayyadamuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Mootummaan Saudi Arabiyaa hanga ammaatti waa'ee haleellaa kanaa ibsa ifa ta'e hin kennine.

title: Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
english: Ukrainian forces have significantly damaged the Crimean Bridge, a key supply route connecting Russia to the occupied peninsula. President Zelensky described the strike as a sophisticated and unprecedented operation that disrupted both road and rail infrastructure. While Russia has vowed to repair the bridge, the attack serves as a major symbolic and logistical setback for their military efforts.
amharic: የዩክሬን ኃይሎች ሩሲያን ከተያዘው የክራይሚያ ልሳነ ምድር ጋር የሚያገናኘውን የክራይሚያ ድልድይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሰውበታል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱን በጥንቃቄ የታቀደ እና ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የረቀቀ ዘመቻ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ምንም እንኳን ሩሲያ ድልድዩን መልሼ እገነባለሁ ብትልም፣ ይህ ጥቃት ለሩሲያ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ትልቅ የሎጂስቲክስ እና የምልክት ተጽዕኖ ፈጣሪ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Yukreen daandii guddicha Raashiyaa fi biyya kutaatti qabame kan ta'e Kirimiyaa wal-quunnamsiisu kan ta'e dambalii Kirimiyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaniiru. Preezidaanti Zelenskii haleellaa kana duula baay'ee qindaa'aa fi kanaan dura hin mul'anne ta'uu ibsaniiru. Raashiyaan daandicha deebisee ijaaruuf waadaa galteus, haleellaan kun hojii waraanaa isaanii irratti miidhaa guddaa fi kan tuffii fakkaatu qaba.

title: Ukraine accuses Russia of targeting rescue operation after 'double-tap' strike kills 72
english: Ukrainian officials report that Russian forces conducted a deadly double-tap strike on a humanitarian center in Komyshuvakha, resulting in at least 72 deaths. The attack involved a second strike specifically targeting rescue workers and emergency equipment as they responded to the initial blast. Ukrainian authorities have condemned this act as a deliberate tactic of terror aimed at preventing aid efforts and harming civilians near the front line.
amharic: የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በኮሚሹቫካ መንደር በሚገኝ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ማዕከል ላይ ተከታታይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታወቁ። የሩሲያ ወታደሮች የመጀመሪያው ጥቃት በደረሰበት ቦታ ላይ የነበሩ አዳኞችን እና የድንገተኛ አደጋ መኪናዎችን ሆን ብለው እንደገና በመምታታቸው ቢያንስ 72 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። ዩክሬን ይህ ድርጊት የሲቪል ነዋሪዎችን ለመጉዳት እና የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን ለማደናቀፍ የታለመ የአሸባሪነት ተግባር ነው በማለት ከሰሰች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Yukreen akka ibsanitti, waraanni Raashiyaa bakka gargaarsa namoomaa biyya Komishuvaakhaatti erga haleelaa jalqabaa raawwatee booda, lammata bakka sanatti haleellaa raawwachuun namoota 72 ol ajjeeseera. Haleellaan lammaffaan kun kan xiyyeeffate namoota gargaarsa kennuuf dhufanii fi konkolaattota ariifachiisaa irratti ture. Yukreen gochi kun hojii gargaarsa namoomaa gufachiisuuf fi nagaa-bultoota miidhuuf kan raawwatame 'shororkeessummaa' akka ta'e himatteerti.

title: Indian woman gang-raped while pregnant in 2002 'heartbroken' after two perpetrators bailed
english: Bilkis Bano, a survivor of a brutal gang-rape during the 2002 Gujarat riots, has expressed deep distress after the Indian Supreme Court granted bail to two of her convicted attackers. The court cited the convicts' long incarceration and health concerns as reasons for the temporary release, while they await a final ruling on their appeals. Bano’s legal team emphasized that this decision is a significant setback that forces the survivor to continue her exhausting fight for justice.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ2002 በጉጃራት ግጭት ወቅት የቡድን አስገድዶ መድፈር ሰለባ የነበረችው ቢልኪስ ባኖ፣ ጥቃት ካደረሱባት አጥፊዎች ሁለቱ በሕንድ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት በዋስ መፈታታቸውን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ሐዘን እንደተሰማት ገልጻለች። ፍርድ ቤቱ ለዚህ ውሳኔ ምክንያቶች ሲል ያስቀመጠው፣ ወንጀለኞቹ ከ17 ዓመታት በላይ በእስር መቆየታቸውን እና የጤና ችግር እንዳለባቸው ነው። የባኖ ጠበቆች ይህ ውሳኔ ለፍትህ የምታደርገውን ትግል እንደሚያስተጓጉል እና ተጎጂዋን በጥልቅ እንዳሳዘናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Namni bara 2002 finxaaleeyyii Gujarat yeroo gubachaa turetti gudeedamtee fi maatiin ishee ajjeefaman Bilkis Baanoon, yakka kana raawwatanii kan hidhaman namoota lamaaf mana murtii olaanaan Hindii wabii erga hayyamee booda gadda cimaa keessa akka jirtu ibsite. Manni murtichaa namoonni kunneen waggoota 17 oliif hidhamaa turuu fi rakkoo fayyaa qabaachuu isaanii sababeeffachuun gadhiifamuu isaanii ibse. Abukaatoon Baanoo murtichi dhaddacha haqaa argachuuf isheen gochaa jirtu irratti dhiibbaa guddaa akka uumu fi miira ishee miidhuu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: Imran Khan seeks urgent medical care fearing he 'may not return alive'
english: Imran Khan, the former Prime Minister of Pakistan, has requested immediate medical attention, claiming that his health and his wife's health are rapidly failing under prison conditions. He expressed fears that his medical risks, including potential heart and brain issues, could prove fatal while in custody. Conversely, government officials deny these allegations, insisting he receives proper care and remains in stable health.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን በእስር ቤት የጤና ሁኔታቸው እና የሚስታቸው ሁኔታ እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ አስቸኳይ የህክምና እርዳታ እንዲደረግላቸው ጠይቀዋል። በእስር ላይ እያሉ ለልብ እና ለአንጎል ህመም ተጋላጭ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ህይወታቸው አደጋ ላይ እንደሆነ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። የፓኪስታን መንግስት ባለስልጣናት ግን የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር በቂ የህክምና ክትትል እየተደረገላቸው እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Paakistaan duraanii Imraan Kaan, haalli fayyaa isaanii fi haadha manaa isaanii hidha keessatti hammaachuu isaa ibsuun yaalii hatattamaa gaafatan. Hidha keessatti rakkoolee onnee fi sammuu qabaachuu danda'an irraa kan ka'e lubbuun isaanii darbuu akka malu sodaa qaban ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Paakistaan garuu himannaa kana haaluun, namni kun yaalii fayyaa gahaa argachaa akka jiru fi haalli fayyaa isaanii tasgabbaa'aa ta'uu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Who is behind Habibi UK, an X account that targeted critics of Israel?
english: An investigation by Byline Times has revealed that the anonymous X account 'Habibi UK,' which frequently attacked critics of Israel, was operated by Benjamin Tait, a former US Foreign Service officer. The account was part of a network of anonymous profiles that targeted numerous public figures, including politicians and broadcasters, for their stance on the war in Gaza. Following the exposure of his identity, the account ceased its online activities.
amharic: የባይላይን ታይምስ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው 'ሀቢቢ ዩኬ' የተሰኘውና የእስራኤልን ጦርነት የሚቃወሙ ሰዎችን ሲያጠቁ የነበሩ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ገጾች በቤንጃሚን ታይት የተባሉ የቀድሞ የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማት የሚመሩ እንደነበሩ ተገልጧል። ይህ የትዊተር (ኤክስ) አካውንት በጋዛ ጦርነት ላይ ያላቸውን አቋም የገለጹ የፖለቲካ ሰዎችን እና ጋዜጠኞችን ጨምሮ በርካታ ታዋቂ ግለሰቦችን ያጠቃ ነበር። የማንነታቸው መጋለጥን ተከትሎ አካውንቱ መለጠፍ አቁሟል።
oromo: Qorannoon 'Byline Times' gaggeesse akka ibsetti, akaawuntii 'Habibi UK' jedhamu kan gargaarsa Israa'el mormuun beekamu, hojii Benjamin Tait jedhamu kan duraan hojjataa mootummaa Ameerikaa turetiin akka hoogganamu mirkaneesseera. Akaawuntiin kun namoota beekamoo siyaasaa fi miidiyaa dabalatee, mormitoota waraana Gaazaa irratti duula gaggeessaa ture. Erga eenyummaan isaa ifoomee booda, akaawuntichi ergaa maxxansuu dhaabeera.

title: Fomula One champion Fernando Alonso to race at Dakar Rally 2027
english: Two-time Formula One champion Fernando Alonso has announced his return to the Dakar Rally in 2027. Driving for the Aston Martin team alongside co-driver Marc Coma, he plans to balance this endurance challenge with his ongoing Formula One racing career. The event will take place in Morocco and Portugal next January, marking a major milestone for Aston Martin's debut in rally-raid competition.
amharic: የሁለት ጊዜ የፎርሙላ ዋን አሸናፊ ፈርናንዶ አሎንሶ በ2027 በሚካሄደው የዳካር 랠ይ ውድድር እንደሚሳተፍ አስታውቋል። አሎንሶ ከአጋር አሽከርካሪው ማርክ ኮማ ጋር በመሆን ለአስተን ማርቲን ቡድን የሚወዳደር ሲሆን፣ በዚሁ ዓመት በፎርሙላ ዋን ውድድርም እንደሚቀጥል ገልጿል። ውድድሩ በሚቀጥለው ጥር ወር በሞሮኮ እና በፖርቱጋል የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለአስተን ማርቲን በራሊ ውድድር የመጀመሪያ ተሳትፎው ነው።
oromo: Injifataan tapha Formula One yeroo lamaa Fernando Alonso, bara 2027 qophii Dakar Rally irratti akka hirmaatu beeksiseera. Inni garee Aston Martin waliin fi gargaaraa isaa Marc Coma waliin ta'uun, qophii kana fi dorgommii Formula One wal-faana gaggeessuuf karoorfateera. Dorgommiin kun ji'a Amajjii dhufu biyya Morocco fi Portugal keessatti kan gaggeeffamu yoo ta'u, kunis carraa jalqabaa Aston Martin dorgommii raalii irratti hirmaatu ta'a.

title: Why are five EU countries reviving plans to deport migrants to Rwanda?
english: Five European Union nations, including Germany and the Netherlands, have proposed a plan to transfer rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda starting in 2027. This initiative aims to create an external hub where migrants ordered to leave Europe can be accommodated while they either integrate into Rwandan society or seek other destinations. While participating governments believe this will streamline deportations, human rights organizations have raised concerns regarding the potential for mistreatment and the ethics of the arrangement.
amharic: ጀርመን እና ኔዘርላንድስን ጨምሮ አምስት የአውሮፓ ህብረት ሀገራት፣ ጥያቄያቸው ውድቅ የተደረገባቸውን ስደተኞች ከ2027 ጀምሮ ወደ ሩዋንዳ ለመላክ ተስማምተዋል። ይህ ዕቅድ ስደተኞች በአውሮፓ ውስጥ የመኖር መብት በማይኖራቸው ጊዜ፣ በሩዋንዳ በሚቋቋም ማዕከል እንዲቆዩ እና ወደፊትም በዚያው እንዲዋሃዱ ወይም ወደ ሌላ ሀገር እንዲሄዱ ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው። መንግስታቱ ይህ እርምጃ ህገ-ወጥ ስደተኞችን የመመለስ ሂደትን ያፋጥናል ብለው ቢያምኑም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን ስደተኞች ሊደርስባቸው የሚችለውን ጥቃት በመስጋት ፕሮግራሙን ይቃወማሉ።
oromo: Biyyoonni gamtaa Awurooppaa shan, Jarmanii fi Nezerlaandiin dabalatee, baqattoota gaaffiin isaanii dide gara Ruwaandaatti erguuf karoorfatan. Karoorri kun namoonni hayyama jireenyaa Awurooppaa keessatti hin qabne gara Ruwaandaatti geeffamanii, achitti akka jiraatan ykn biyya biraa akka filatan taasisa. Mootummoonni kun tarkaanfichi deebii godaantotaa saffisiisa jedhanii kan amanan yoo ta'u, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa garuu namoonni kunneen miidhaaf saaxilamuu danda'u jedhanii yaaddoo qabu.

title: US President Trump arrives in Manila ahead of ASEAN summit
english: US President Donald Trump has arrived in Manila to attend a special meeting between the United States and ASEAN leaders. Following this event, he plans to travel to China for the APEC summit. During his upcoming trip, he is expected to hold discussions with both President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir Putin of Russia.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ እና በአሴያን (ASEAN) መሪዎች መካከል የሚደረገውን ልዩ ስብሰባ ለመሳተፍ ወደ ማኒላ ገብተዋል። ከዚህ ስብሰባ በኋላ በቻይና በሚካሄደው የኤፔክ (APEC) ጉባኤ ላይ ለመገኘት ይጓዛሉ። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅትም ከቻይናው ፕሬዚዳንት ሺ ጂንፒንግ እና ከሩሲያው ፕሬዚዳንት ቭላዲሚር ፑቲን ጋር ውይይት እንደሚያደርጉ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp walgahii addaa kan biyyoota Ameerikaa fi ASEAN gidduutti gaggeeffamu irratti hirmaachuuf magaalaa Maaniilaa gahaniru. Walgahii kana booda, Pireezidaantiin kun gabaa APEC kan Chaayinaatti gaggeeffamu irratti hirmaachuuf gara biyyattii imalu. Imala isaanii kanaanis Pireezidaantii Chaayinaa Shi Jiinpiingii fi Pireezidaantii Raashiyaa Vilaadimiir Puutiin waliin marii ni godhu jedhamee eegama.

title: Afghanistan women defy Taliban ban to pursue their ambitions in secret
english: Despite strict Taliban restrictions that limit their freedom and educational opportunities, Afghan women are finding ways to follow their goals in secret. These women refuse to abandon their ambitions even as the current regime enforces laws that suppress their personal growth. By working underground, they continue to strive for their dreams despite the significant risks involved.
amharic: የታሊባን አስተዳደር በሴቶች መብት ላይ ጥብቅ እገዳዎችን ቢጥልም፣ የአፍጋኒስታን ሴቶች ህልማቸውን ለማሳካት በድብቅ እየተንቀሳቀሱ ይገኛሉ። አሁን ያለው አገዛዝ ነፃነታቸውን የሚገድብ ህግ ቢኖረውም፣ እነዚህ ሴቶች ተስፋ ሳይቆርጡ ግባቸውን ለማሳካት ጥረታቸውን ቀጥለዋል። ምንም እንኳን ከፍተኛ አደጋ ቢኖርባቸውም፣ በድብቅ ስራዎቻቸውና ጥረታቸው መብታቸውን ለማስከበር እየተጋሩ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Taliban mirga dubartootaa irratti uggura cimaa kaa'us, dubartoonni Afgaanistaan hawwii isaanii milkeeffachuuf haala dhokataa ta'een socho'aa jiru. Bulchiinsi ammaa mirga isaanii kan daangessu ta'us, dubartoonni kunneen abdii kutachuu diduun galma isaanii gahuuf carraaqqii isaanii itti fufaniiru. Miidhaa isaan mudachuu danda'u hunda otoo hin sodaatin, iccitiidhaan fedhii fi kaayyoo isaanii dhugoomsuuf halkanii guyyaa tattaafachaa jiru.

title: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy
english: Houthi rebels have gained control of the Yemeni Red Sea coastline, threatening the critical Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital passage for global maritime trade. This advance jeopardizes Saudi Arabia’s alternative oil export route, which was established to avoid regional instability elsewhere. The situation raises significant concerns that further disruptions to these shipping lanes could trigger global economic instability and higher fuel prices.
amharic: የሁቲ አማጽያን በየመን የቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ቁጥጥር በማድረጋቸው ለዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ መርከቦች ወሳኝ የሆነውን የባብ አል-ማንዳብ ስትሬት ስጋት ላይ ጥለዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ሌሎች አካባቢዎች ካለው አለመረጋጋት ለመራቅ ትጠቀምበት የነበረውን አማራጭ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መንገድ አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል። በነዚህ የባህር መስመሮች ላይ የሚፈጠር ማንኛውም መስተጓጎል በዓለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ጫና በመፍጠር የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲንር ሊያደርግ ይችላል።
oromo: Warra Hutiin qarqara galaana diimaa Yaman to'annoo isaanii jala galchuun, iddoo daldala addunyaaf murteessaa ta'e Bab al-Mandab irratti soda uumaniiru. Tarkaanfin kun, Sa'udii Arabiyaan bakka biroo keessatti waraana fi bu'aa ba'ii irraa ooluuf iddoo gurgurtaan ishee itti fayyadamaa turte miidhuu danda'a. Haalli kun, yoo daandiiwwan galaana kanaa cufaman ykn midhaman, dinagdee addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu fi gatiin boba'aa akka dabalu sodaa uumee jira.

title: Yemeni army reports 661 attacks on Houthis as group advances towards Aden
english: The Yemeni military launched over 600 strikes against Houthi forces in a major counter-offensive, resulting in 173 Houthi casualties and significant equipment destruction. These actions occur as the government attempts to regroup and defend its temporary capital, Aden, following recent territorial losses to Houthi fighters near the Red Sea. In tandem with the military campaign, the Yemeni parliament has officially labeled the Houthi movement a terrorist organization to restrict its operations and funding.
amharic: የየመን ጦር በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ከ600 በላይ ጥቃቶችን በመፈጸም 173 ተዋጊዎችን መግደሉን ወይም ማቁሰሉን አስታውቋል። ይህ ዘመቻ የተካሄደው የየመን መንግሥት በቅርቡ የተወሰዱበትን ቦታዎች በማስመለስ ጊዜያዊ መቀመጫው የሆነችውን ኤደን ከተማን ለመከላከል በሚያደርገው ጥረት ውስጥ ነው። ከዚህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ጎን ለጎን፣ የየመን ፓርላማ የሁቲ ቡድንን እንደ አሸባሪ ድርጅት በመፈረጅ የገንዘብ እና የጦር መሳርያ አቅርቦታቸውን ለመገደብ ወስኗል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Yaman humnoota Huutii irratti haleellaa 600 ol gaggeessuun, lolaa 173 ta’an ajjeesuus ykn madeessuus isaa beeksiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, mootummaan Yaman bakka dhabe deebisee qabachuufi magaalaa Aden ittisuuf yaalii gochaa jiru keessatti. Tarkaanfii waraana kana cinaatti, mana maree Yaman garee Huutii akka dhaabbata shororkeessaaatti moggaasuun, sosochii fi deeggarsa qarshii isaanii ittisuuf murteesseera.

title: Irish court jails man for life over Dublin knife attack that sparked riots
english: A 52-year-old man named Riad Bouchaker has been sentenced to life in prison for a 2023 knife attack in Dublin that severely injured three children and a woman. The horrific incident occurred outside a school and caused one young victim to suffer permanent, life-altering disabilities. Following the attack, false information spread online, leading to significant civil unrest and riots across the Irish capital.
amharic: ሪያድ ቡቻከር የተባለ የ52 ዓመት ሰው እ.ኤ.አ በ2023 በደብሊን ሶስት ህጻናትን እና አንዲት ሴትን በቢላ በመውጋቱ የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። በትምህርት ቤት አቅራቢያ የተፈጸመው ይህ አሰቃቂ ጥቃት በአንዲት ህጻን ላይ ዘላቂ ጉዳት አስከትሏል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ በማህበራዊ ድረ-ገጾች በተሰራጨ የተሳሳተ መረጃ ምክንያት በደብሊን ከተማ ከፍተኛ ረብሻ እና ሁከት ተቀስቅሶ ነበር።
oromo: Namni umuriin isaa waggaa 52, Riyaad Buuchaaker jedhamu, bara 2023 magaalaa Dabliin keessatti ijoollee sadii fi dubartii tokko waraane miidhuusaatiin hidha cimaa waggaa guutuu itti murteeffame. Haleellaan suukanneessaan mana barumsaa fuulduratti raawwatame kun miidhaa qaamaa cimaa ijoollee xiqqaarratti geessiseera. Haleellaa kana booda odeeffannoo sobaa marsariitiiwwan hawaasaa irratti faca'een walqabatee, magaalaa Dabliin keessatti jeequmsi guddaanii fi fincilli uumamee ture.

title: EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
english: Several European nations, including Germany and Greece, have reached an agreement to establish a migration processing hub in Rwanda. This facility will house individuals whose asylum applications have been rejected by EU member states. The centre is expected to become operational by 2027.
amharic: የጀርመንን እና የግሪክን ጨምሮ በርካታ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት በሩዋንዳ የስደተኞች መመለሻ ማዕከል ለማቋቋም ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። ይህ ማዕከል በአውሮፓ ህብረት አባል ሀገራት የጥገኝነት ጥያቄያቸው ውድቅ የተደረገባቸውን ሰዎች የሚያስተናግድ ይሆናል። ማዕከሉ በ2027 ዓ.ም. ሙሉ በሙሉ ስራ ይጀምራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa hedduun, kanneen akka Jarmanii fi Giriikii, Ruwaandaa keessatti bakka godaantota deebisan hundeessuuf waliigalteerra ga'aniiru. Bakki kun namoota biyyoota Gamtaa Awurooppaa keessatti hayyama dawoo dhaban kan keessummeessu ta'a. Buufatni kun bara 2027tti hojii akka jalqabu ni eegama.

title: Ukraine holds peace talks with US, Europe as conflict escalates
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has engaged in complex peace discussions with US and European representatives to address the ongoing conflict. Despite these diplomatic efforts, tensions remain high as both Russia and Ukraine have exchanged significant attacks on key infrastructure, including bridges and oil facilities. US officials involved in the talks noted that while progress is being made, reaching a final peace agreement will require difficult compromises from all sides.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በጦርነቱ ላይ መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ ከአሜሪካ እና ከአውሮፓ ተወካዮች ጋር አስቸጋሪ የሰላም ንግግሮችን እያደረጉ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች ቢኖሩም፣ ሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን በድልድዮች እና በነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥቃቶችን በመፈጸማቸው ውጥረቱ አሁንም ከፍተኛ ነው። በንግግሮቹ ውስጥ የተሳተፉ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ምንም እንኳን የእድገት ምልክቶች ቢታዩም፣ የመጨረሻ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ሁሉም ወገኖች ከባድ ውሳኔዎችን መወሰን እንዳለባቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimiir Zelenski waraana kana xumuruuf jecha bakka bu'oota Ameerikaa fi Awurooppaa waliin marii nagaa ulfaataa ta'e gochaa jiru. Tattaaffii diippiloomaasii kana jiraatus, biyyoonni lameen bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi iddoowwan qulqullina boba'aa irratti haleellaa cimaa raawwachaa waan jiraniif walitti bu'iinsi kun itti fufee jira. Qaamoleen marii kana irratti hirmaatan akka jedhanitti, furmaata dhumaa irratti gahuuf gamni hunduu murtoo cimaa akka fudhatu gaafata jedhaniiru.

title: UK seeks closer ties with EU after Brexit fail
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has admitted that Brexit has caused more economic damage than benefits over the last decade. He is now pushing for a closer relationship with the European Union to reverse the country's growing isolation and improve trade. A key summit is planned this Friday, where the government hopes to finalize agreements on energy, food exports, and youth work mobility.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የብሬክዚት ውሳኔ ባለፉት አስር አመታት ከጥቅሙ ይልቅ ጉዳቱ እንዳመዘነ ገልጸዋል። አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ ሀገሪቱ ያጋጠማትን ዓለም አቀፍ መገለል ለመቅረፍ ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር እየሰሩ ነው። በዚህ አርብ በሚካሄድ ወሳኝ ስብሰባ ላይ በሃይል፣ በምግብ ንግድ እና በወጣቶች የሥራ ልውውጥ ዙሪያ አዳዲስ ስምምነቶችን ለመፈራረም መንግስት እቅድ ይዟል።
oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Biriteen Andy Burnham, Brexit waggoota kurnan darban keessa fayidaarra miidhaa guddaa akka geessise ibsaniiru. Yeroo ammaa biyyattii addunyaarraa adda baatee jirtu deebisanii gabbisuuf, Gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin hariiroo cimaa uumuu akka barbaadan beekameera. Jimaata dhufu walgahii guddaa gaggeeffamu irratti, mootummaan dhimmoota anniisaa, daldala midhaan nyaataa fi carraa hojii dargaggootaa irratti waliigaltee haarawa taasisuuf karoorfateera.

title: Vance says war on Iran will not become a long-term commitment
english: US Vice President JD Vance stated that any potential military action against Iran will not result in a prolonged, multi-year conflict. While acknowledging that Iran's nuclear activities pose a security risk to the United States, he emphasized that the government is committed to a short-term approach. Vance expressed confidence that the current administration will achieve its objectives quickly and withdraw American forces without an indefinite engagement.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ከኢራን ጋር ሊኖር ስለሚችል ወታደራዊ ግጭት ሲናገሩ፣ ይህ ጦርነት ለረጅም ጊዜ የሚዘልቅ እንደማይሆን ገልጸዋል። የኢራን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ለአሜሪካ ስጋት መሆኑን ቢጠቅሱም፣ መንግሥታቸው ግጭቱን ለብዙ ዓመታት ለማቆየት ፍላጎት እንደሌለው አስረድተዋል። አሁን ያለው አስተዳደር ግቡን በፍጥነት አሳክቶ ወታደሮቹን በቅርቡ እንደሚያስወጣ ሙሉ እምነት እንዳላቸው ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Itti-aanaan Pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance akka jedhanitti, lola gara fuulduraa kan Iran wajjin ta’uu danda’u yeroo dheeraaf kan turu miti. Sagantaan niwukilaraa Iran biyya Ameerikaaf yaaddoo ta’us, mootummaan isaanii lola kana waggoota hedduuf tursiisuuf karoora akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Pirezidaantichi kaayyoo isaa dafee galmaan gahuun waraana Ameerikaa yeroodhaan akka baasu guutummaatti amanuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Casualties in Israeli settler attack rises
english: Israeli settlers carried out a shooting attack in the West Bank village of al-Duyuk al-Tahta, resulting in the death of a 60-year-old woman. Additionally, ten other individuals, including a 65-year-old man, sustained injuries during the incident. Authorities are currently reporting an increase in the number of casualties following this violent assault near Jericho.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ አል-ዱዩክ አል-ታህታ መንደር በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በተፈጸመ ተኩስ የአርባ ዓመት ሴት ህይወት አልፏል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም አንድ የ65 ዓመት አዛውንትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች አስር ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በኢያሪኮ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመው በዚህ ጥቃት የተጎጂዎች ቁጥር እየጨመረ መምጣቱ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Godina Lixaa (West Bank) ganda al-Duyuk al-Tahta jedhamutti namoota qubatanii jiraatan kan Israa'el ta'aniin dhukaasa banameen dubartii umriin ishee waggaa 60 ta'e lubbuun ishee darbeera. Kana malees, namoonni biroo kudhan kan keessatti argaman yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa dhiira umriin isaa waggaa 65 ta'e tokko madaa'eera. Miidhaan kun kan mudate magaalaa Yerikoo cinaatti yoo ta'u, lakkoofsi namoota miidhamanii dabalaa jiraachuu gabaasameera.

title: Watch: Arab-Israeli party denounces Netanyahu over 'attempted coup'
english: Yousef Jabareen of the Arab-Israeli Joint List has accused outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of orchestrating an attempted coup. These allegations stem from reports claiming Netanyahu's office plotted to frame Arab politicians prior to the recent election. Jabareen emphasized that the severity of these claims requires a thorough investigation and cannot be ignored.
amharic: የአረብ-እስራኤል የጋራ ዝርዝር ፓርቲ መሪ የሆኑት ዩሴፍ ጃባሪን፣ ከስልጣን እየወረዱ ባሉት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ላይ የመፈንቅለ መንግስት ሙከራ ፈጽመዋል ሲሉ ከሰሱ። ይህ ክስ የተሰነዘረው የኔታንያሁ ቢሮ ባለፈው ወር በተካሄደው ምርጫ ወቅት አረብ ፖለቲከኞችን በማዕቀፍ ለመክሰስ መሞከሩን የሚገልጹ ዘገባዎች በመውጣታቸው ነው። ጃባሪን የክሱ ክብደት ከፍተኛ በመሆኑ ጉዳዩ በቸልታ ሊታለፍ እንደማይገባ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii 'Joint List' kanneen akka Yuuseef Jaabareen, muummichi ministeeraa aangoo gadi lakkisaa jiran Beniyaamiin Neetaan yaahuu yaalii fonqolcha mootummaa godhaniiru jechuun himatan. Himannaan kun kan ka'e, biiroon Neetaan yaahuu filannoo darbe dura siyaasota Arabaa irratti yakka sobaa akka dhaaban gabaasni ifoomuun isaa hordofee dha. Jaabareen himannaan kun hamma akkasii waan ta'eef, dhimmi kun akka salphaatti ilaalamuu akka hin qabne ibseera.

title: Israeli settlers shoot, wound five Palestinians near Jericho, Red Crescent says
english: Five Palestinians were injured after being shot by Israeli settlers in the West Bank village of al-Duyuk al-Tahta, located near Jericho. Medical reports confirming the incident were provided by the Palestinian Red Crescent. The attack occurred in the occupied territory as part of ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: በኢያሪኮ አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው አል-ዱዩክ አል-ታህታ መንደር በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በተከፈተ ጥይት አምስት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ጉዳዩን የፍልስጤም ቀይ ጨረቃ ማህበር ያረጋገጠ ሲሆን ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች በህክምና ላይ እንደሚገኙ ተገልጿል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Yerikoo ganda Al-Duyuk Al-Tahta jedhamutti namoonni saba Israa'eel irraa dhufan dhukaasa bananiin lammiileen Falasxiin shan miidhamaniiru. Dhaabbanni Gargaarsa Gadaadduu (Red Crescent) Falasxiin akka ibsetti, miidhamtoonni kun wal'ansa fayyaa argachaa jiru. Miidhaan kun kan qaqqabe naannoo Qilleensa Qilleensaa (West Bank) kan qabame keessatti dha.

title: Tanker transiting Strait of Hormuz attacked near Oman: UKMTO
english: A tanker ship was struck by an attack while passing through the Strait of Hormuz near Oman, causing an engine room fire that left the vessel disabled. Although the ship sustained damage, all crew members are reported to be safe. Authorities are currently assessing the full impact of the incident.
amharic: በኦማን አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ውስጥ ሲጓዝ የነበረ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ ጥቃት ደርሶበታል። ጥቃቱ በመርከቧ የሞተር ክፍል ውስጥ እሳት በማስነሳት መርከቧ የመንቀሳቀስ አቅሟን እንድታጣ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን በመርከቧ ላይ ጉዳት ቢደርስም፣ ሁሉም የመርከቡ ሠራተኞች ደህና መሆናቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Dooniin boba'aa fe'atte tokko yeroo gara Ormaanitti dhiyaatu qaxxaamuraa Hormuz keessa jirtu haleellaan ishee mudateera. Haleellaan kun kutaa injiinii doonichaa keessatti ibidda kaasuun dooniin sun akka hin sochoone godheera. Dooniin sun miidhamus, hojjattoonni hundi nagaa akka qaban gabaafameera.

title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
english: Five European nations, including Germany and the Netherlands, have partnered with Rwanda to establish a deportation hub for migrants who have no legal right to remain in the EU. Scheduled to begin in 2027, the program will initially focus on single men and provide them with the choice to either settle in Rwanda with access to local services or return to their home countries. While these governments argue the plan will reduce the burden on European asylum systems and deter human traffickers, human rights organizations have raised concerns about the potential violation of migrant rights.
amharic: ጀርመንንና ኔዘርላንድስን ጨምሮ አምስት የአውሮፓ ሀገራት በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ የሚገኙ ስደተኞችን ወደ ሩዋንዳ የሚልኩበት ማዕከል ለመክፈት ተስማምተዋል። በ2027 የሚጀመረው ይህ ፕሮግራም በመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ለብቻቸው ለሚጓዙ ወንዶች ትኩረት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን፣ ስደተኞቹ በሩዋንዳ የመኖር ወይም ወደ ሀገራቸው የመመለስ አማራጭ ይኖራቸዋል። አባል ሀገራቱ ይህ እርምጃ የአውሮፓን የስደተኞች አያያዝ ጫና እንደሚቀንስ ቢገልጹም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን የሰውን ልጅ መብት ሊጥስ ይችላል በሚል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa shan kanneen akka Jarmanii fi Neezerlaandi, godaantota biyya isaanii keessa seeraan ala turan gara Ruwaandaatti erguuf waliigaltee tokko mallatteessaniiru. Sagantaan bara 2027 eegaluu kun jalqaba irratti dhiirota kophaa isaanii godaanan irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, godaantonni kunneen Ruwaandaa keessa jiraachuuf ykn gara biyya isaaniitti deebi'uuf carraa ni qabaatu. Biyyoonni kunneen tarkaanfin kun sirna godaantotaa Awurooppaa irratti jiru salphisa jedhanii kan amananii fi seeraan walsimu jedhanis, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa garuu mirga godaantotaa cabsuu danda'a jechuun yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Trump backs return of ex-Nvidia boss after 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign launched
english: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is facing calls for reinstatement from high-profile tech figures and supporters following his resignation over personal scandals. President Donald Trump has expressed support for his return, even as Nvidia's board maintains that they are not considering rehiring him. Meanwhile, the Trump administration has implemented tighter restrictions on AI chip exports to prevent China from accessing advanced technology.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ ዋና ሥራ አስፈፃሚ የነበሩት ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ በግል ቅሌቶች ምክንያት ከሥራ መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ፣ አንዳንድ የቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፍ መሪዎችና ደጋፊዎቻቸው ወደ ሥራቸው እንዲመለሱ እየጠየቁ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሁዋንግ ወደ ሥራቸው ቢመለሱ እንደማይቃወሙ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ የኤንቪዲያ ቦርድ ግን እንደገና የመቅጠር ፍላጎት እንደሌለው አስታውቋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ የአሜሪካ መንግሥት ቻይና የላቀ የኤአይ ቺፕ ቴክኖሎጂን እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል የወጪ ንግድ ገደቦችን አጠናክሯል።
oromo: Hogganaan duraanii dhaabbata Nvidia Jensen Huang, dhimma ejjannoo dhuunfaatiin walqabatee hojiirraa erga gadi bu'anii booda, deeggarsa gurguddoo namoota tekinooloojii biraa argachaa jiru. Prezidaantiin Donald Trump deebii isaanii kan deggaran ta'us, boordiin Nvidia ammayyuu gara hojiitti deebisuuf yaadne hin jiru jedheera. Kana gidduutti, mootummaan Trump tekinooloojii AI kan ta'e chipiiwwan gara Chaayinaatti akka hin geenyeef daangaa daldalaa haaraya baaseera.

title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
english: Russia recently faced its largest drone attack since the war started, with over 2,000 drones launched at various targets. The assault caused minor damage to the strategic Kerch Bridge connecting Russia to Crimea and sparked fires at several oil refineries. In retaliation, Russian strikes hit Kyiv and disrupted power for 50,000 people, resulting in at least seven deaths amid ongoing high-level peace discussions.
amharic: ሩሲያ ጦርነቱ ከተጀመረ ወዲህ ትልቁ የተባለውን የድሮን ጥቃት አስተናግዳለች፤ ከሁለት ሺህ በላይ ድሮኖች በተለያዩ ኢላማዎች ላይ ተጠቅመዋል። ጥቃቱ ሩሲያን ከክሬሚያ ጋር የሚያገናኘውን የከርች ድልድይ ላይ ቀላል ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን በነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይም የእሳት አደጋ አስከትሏል። ለዚህ ምላሽ በወሰደችው እርምጃ ሩሲያ በኪቭ ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘሯ በሃምሳ ሺህ ሰዎች ላይ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ አጋጥሟል፤ እንዲሁም ሰባት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል።
oromo: Raashiyaan jalqaba waraanaa irraa kaasee kan ta’e weerara xiyyaaraa kanaan dura hin mul’anne kan muuxatte yoo ta’u, xiyyaaronni 2,000 ol ta’an imala isaanii gara garaa irratti gaggeeffamaniiru. Weerara kanaan daandiin ce’umsaa Kerch kan Raashiyaa fi Crimea wal qunnamsiisu miidhaa xiqqoo irra ga’eera, akkasumas lafa gubataa boba’aa tokko tokko irratti ibidni ka’eera. Raashiyaan gama isheen, magaalaa Kyiv irratti tarkaanfii fudhatteen namoonni torba du’anii, namoonni 50,000 immoo ifaa dhabaniiru.

title: When will we see Robert Pattinson as Bond in cinemas?
english: Robert Pattinson has been officially cast as the seventh actor to play the legendary spy James Bond. The upcoming film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve and is scheduled to begin production in 2027. While a specific release date has not been confirmed, the movie is expected to arrive in theaters in 2028.
amharic: ሮበርት ፓቲንሰን ታዋቂውን ሰላይ ጄምስ ቦንድን የሚጫወት ሰባተኛው ተዋናይ ሆኖ በይፋ ተመርጧል። ፊልሙ በዴኒስ ቪልኑቭ የሚመራ ሲሆን ቀረጻውም በ2027 እንደሚጀመር ይጠበቃል። ምንም እንኳን ትክክለኛው ቀን ባይገለጽም፣ ፊልሙ በ2028 ወደ ሲኒማ ቤቶች እንደሚመጣ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Robert Pattinson akka ta'e 007 (James Bond) kan taphatu ta'uun isaa ifatti beekameera. Filmiin kun kan qajeelfamu Denis Villeneuve-dhaan yoo ta'u, hojiin suuraa kaasuus bara 2027 akka eegalu ni eegama. Guyyaan inni itti gadhiifamu hanga ammaatti kan hin murtoofne ta'us, bara 2028 akka qophaa'uuf karoorfameera.

title: Five EU countries announce plan to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda
english: Five European nations, including Germany and Austria, are planning to send asylum seekers who were denied entry to a processing facility in Rwanda. The initiative aims to discourage illegal migration and disrupt human smuggling networks by offering migrants the option to return home, settle in Rwanda, or move elsewhere. However, numerous human rights organizations have strongly condemned the proposal, expressing serious concerns regarding the safety and potential mistreatment of the displaced individuals.
amharic: ጀርመንንና ኦስትሪያን ጨምሮ አምስት የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ጥያቄያቸው ውድቅ የተደረገባቸውን ጥገኝነት ጠያቂዎች ወደ ሩዋንዳ ለመላክ አቅደዋል። ይህ እቅድ ህገ-ወጥ ስደትን ለመከላከል እና የሰዎች ህገ-ወጥ አዘዋዋሪዎችን ስራ ለማቆም ያለመ ሲሆን፣ ስደተኞች ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ፣ በሩዋንዳ እንዲኖሩ ወይም ወደ ሌላ ቦታ እንዲሄዱ አማራጭ ይሰጣቸዋል። ይሁን እንጂ በርካታ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች የስደተኞችን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ ይጥላል በሚል እቅዱን በጥብቅ ተቃውመዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa shan kanneen akka Jarmanii fi Awustiriyaa, gaaffiin kooluuggattummaa isaanii fudhatama hin argatin gara Ruwaandaatti erguuf karoorfataa jiru. Karoorri kun godaansa seeraan alaa hir'isuu fi gareewwan namoota seeraan alaa godaansisan qabachuu kan kaayyeeffate yoo ta'u, godaantonni gara biyya isaanii deebi'uu, Ruwaandaa keessa jiraachuu ykn gara biyya biraatti deemuu akka danda'an taasiisa. Ta'us, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa hedduun karoora kana jabeessanii mormuun, nageenyaa fi mirga godaantotaa irratti miidhaan dhaqqabuu danda'a jechuun yaaddoo isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia dismisses commander of coalition forces fighting Houthis
english: Saudi Arabia has replaced its top coalition commander, General Fahd bin Hamad al-Salman, with General Fayyad al-Ruwaili. This leadership change occurs as coalition forces retreat from the Red Sea coast to strengthen the defense of Aden, the interim capital of Yemen. The withdrawal follows significant military setbacks against Houthi fighters, who have moved closer to the city after gaining control of key coastal areas.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በየመን የጦር አዛዧን በመቀየር ጄኔራል ፋያድ አል-ሩዋይሊን አዲሱ የጥምረት ኃይሎች አዛዥ አድርጋ ሾማለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የጥምረት ኃይሎች ከቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢዎች በመውጣት የየመንን ጊዜያዊ ዋና ከተማ አደን ለመከላከል በዝግጅት ላይ እያሉ ነው። ሑቲዎች በቅርቡ ወሳኝ የሆኑ የባህር ዳርቻ ቦታዎችን በመቆጣጠር ወደ አደን በመቅረባቸው፣ ጥምረቱ በጦርነቱ ላይ ከፍተኛ ፈተና ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan ajajaa loltootaa ishee kan Yemen keessatti lolaa jiran bakka buustee, General Faayyaad al-Ruwaayilii ajajaa haaraa godhatteetti. Jijjiirraan kun kan godhame yeroo loltoonni kun dirree gara galaana diimaa gadi lakkisanii magaalaa Aden, magaalaa guddoo yerootii taate, ittisuuf qophaa'aa jiranitti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga gareen Huutii bakkeewwan bakka bu'iinsa galaana irratti argaman to'annoo isaanii jala galchanii fi gara magaalaa Adenitti dhihaachuu jalqabanii booda.

title: Thousands report difficulties accessing accounts online at major US banks
english: Numerous customers of major US banks, such as JPMorgan Chase and Wells Fargo, are facing significant technical issues with online services. Users have reported difficulties logging in, checking account balances, and completing fund transfers. Banks have attributed these problems to technical errors rather than cyberattacks and are currently working on restoration.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሚገኙ ዋና ዋና ባንኮች እንደ ጄፒ ሞርጋን ቼዝ እና ዌልስ ፋርጎ ያሉ ተቋማት የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት መስተጓጎል አጋጥሟቸዋል። ደንበኞች ወደ አካውንታቸው በመግባት፣ የሂሳብ መጠናቸውን በማየት እና የገንዘብ ዝውውሮችን ለማድረግ ችግሮች እንዳጋጠሟቸው ገልጸዋል። የባንክ ተቋማቱ ችግሩ የቴክኒክ ብልሽት እንጂ የሳይበር ጥቃት አለመሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ መፍትሄ ለመስጠት እየሰሩ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Baankiwwan gurguddoo Ameerikaa kanneen akka JPMorgan Chase fi Wells Fargo tajaajila interneetii irratti rakkoo mudateen miidhamaniiru. Maamiltoonni gara herrega baankii isaaniitti seenuuf, qabiyyee herregichaa mirkaneeffachuuf, akkasumas maallaqa dabarsuuf rakkoo akka qaban gabaasaniiru. Baankiwwan kun rakkoon kun kan dhufe miidhaa teeknikaatiin malee haleellaa interneetii irraa akka hin taane ibsuun, ariitiin sirreessuuf hojjechaa jiraachuu beeksisaniiru.

title: Is Israel’s Eisenkot bloc less right wing than Netanyahu?
english: As Israel faces complex government formation talks, former military chief Gadi Eisenkot is attempting to build a coalition to move away from Benjamin Netanyahu's hard-right policies. His opposition bloc aims to restore judicial oversight, investigate the security failures of October 7, and mandate military service for ultra-Orthodox youth. However, skeptics question if this new group, which still includes various right-wing figures, will truly represent a significant ideological shift from the previous administration.
amharic: እስራኤል አዲስ መንግስት ለመመስረት በምታደርገው ድርድር፣ የቀድሞው ወታደራዊ መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት የቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የጽንፈኛ ቀኝ አዝማሚያ የለቀቀ ጥምረት ለመመስረት እየሞከሩ ነው። የአይዘንኮት ተቃዋሚ ቡድን የፍትህ ስርአቱን ነጻነት ለመመለስ፣ በጥቅምት 7 የነበረውን የደህንነት ክፍተት ለመመርመር እና ለአልትራ-ኦርቶዶክስ ወጣቶች የግዴታ ወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ለመጣል አቅደዋል። ነገር ግን፣ ይህ አዲስ ቡድን በውስጡ የተለያዩ የቀኝ ዘመም አባላትን የያዘ በመሆኑ፣ ከቀድሞው አስተዳደር የተለየ ለውጥ ያመጣል ወይ የሚለው ጥርጣሬ አለ።
oromo: Israa'el mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf marii geggeessaa jirtuun, ajajaan waraanaa duraanii Gadi Eisenkot yaada Benjamin Netanyahu irraa adda ta'e diriirsuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira. Gareen mormituu Eisenkot seerota mana murtii fooyyessuuf, dogoggora nageenyaa Mudde 7 qorachuuf, akkasumas dargaggoota amantii fayyadamoo ta'aniif tajaajila waraanaa dirqama gochuuf karoorfateera. Haata'u malee, gareen kun namoota mirga-qabiyyee (right-wing) of keessaa qabuuf, mootummaa duraa irraa garaagarummaan guddaan jiraata moo hin jiraatu kan jedhu shakkiin jira.
